canonical_master_reference.usage: READ-ONLY collision flagging; master NOT rewritten or appended by this judge

collision_only_shards_enumerated.usage: wave_b_w4 shards per commission: NONE merged into this accepted list; collisions recorded in offmaster_collision_flags for w4/w5 reconciliation

method: Hypothesis-level cross-shard dedup over N+P+O: ideas compared on core_hypothesis content (mechanism + falsification design), not title strings. Two ideas are duplicates when they assert the same mechanism with the same falsification design, differing only in substrate (task, modality, metric, or the X-slot of a template). Lexical token-Jaccard scans found NO within-wave pair above 0.23, no pair vs the 638-line master above 0.20, and no pair vs gen_k/l/m above 0.18 - duplication in this wave is purely hypothesis-level, so every verdict rests on the judge's manual hypothesis comparison (top lexical pairs were manually adjudicated: P-061/P-065 0.221 merged, P-004/P-027 0.218 merged, P-072/P-075 0.203 merged, N-055/N-068 0.203 kept as distinct mechanisms). FAMILY MEMBERSHIP was treated as a MERGE TRIGGER per the w2 diversity ruling: judge-assigned family cells were capped at <=6 kept primaries; six cells fired or co-fired (amodal_extent_geometry 8->6, decode_time_structural_constraints 8->6, long_tail_capability 7->6, weight_space_merging 7->6, annotation_convention_control, eval_statistics_certificates 7->6) and one sits at cap without merges (resolution_as_scaling_axis, 6). Cells are mechanism-level, not topic-level: gen_o's 13-keep microscopy cluster spans 13 distinct optical mechanisms and no gen_o cell exceeded the cap; a coarser topic-level cell assignment would fire caps against gen_o's cross-domain physics templates, which are instead recorded as permutation flag families (the diversifier mandate argues against merging distinct physics into one slot - recorded as a judgment call for the consolidator). Kept ideas were checked against all 638 accepted master ideas: five near-verbatim substrate ports were killed with master merge targets (N-054 and N-070 into the J-038/J-074 memorization laws - closing the reconciliation duty the w3 judge logged as 'J-038 vs N-053/N-054/N-055'; P-021 into B-095; P-034 into D-096; P-087 into A-094); 47 keeps carry master collision flags; 17 keeps carry flag-only collisions against the w4 shards gen_k/l/m. High-value anomalies protected (23). GATE-5 compliance was mechanically audited per record: gen_n 100/100 and gen_p 104/104 carry numeric kill thresholds and evidence_label dicts; gen_o carries 100/100 evidence labels and 99/100 numeric thresholds, the single exception O-007 stating its kill condition in words - flagged, NOT repaired; no thresholds or labels invented. NO novelty verification performed; every prior-art remark is an unverified judge hypothesis; no citations invented. Canonical state untouched.

gate5_missing_kill_threshold.note: mechanical test = presence of a digit in falsifiable_prediction; any listed id states its threshold in words (see gate5_record)

gate5_record.duty: GATE-5 (w2 diversity decision): every record carries a numeric kill threshold in falsifiable_prediction and an evidence_label dict, or the judge flags it.
gate5_record.finding: Mechanical audit (digit present in falsifiable_prediction; evidence_label dict present): gen_n 100/100 thresholds + 100/100 labels; gen_p 104/104 + 104/104; gen_o 99/100 thresholds + 100/100 labels. The single exception is O-007, whose falsifiable_prediction states its kill condition in words (slope-matching within stated tolerance) rather than digits; its evidence_label is present. Flagged in judge_A_meta.gate5 of O-007; this judge did NOT rewrite the threshold (inventing a number is threshold-fabrication). Wave w5 is therefore effectively GATE-5 clean, unlike w3: no retrofit block is needed before master merge, pending judge B/C confirmation of O-007.
gate5_record.gate6_note: Genre self-declarations not re-audited here: gen_p self-declares wholesale constructive_capability and gen_o characterization/audit-heavy genres; GATE-6 phrasing re-audit belongs to the consolidator before genre quotas are applied.

dg01_mixture_response_law.reason: N-034 (domain-share effects on log-error are additive, so mixture response surfaces are predictable from single-domain sweeps) is the leading functional-form hypothesis inside N-023's domain-mixture scaling-law program; both are falsified by the same held-out-mixture prediction error on pilot grids. Factorial-primary precedent (w3 dg01).

dg02_repetition_optimum.reason: Same mechanism (vision contrastive pretraining tolerates repetition far beyond the one-epoch language lore; effective-data decay per epoch is small) and same design (unique-data vs repetition factor at matched samples seen, probe-accuracy optimum curves). N-039's above-one optimal epoch count is the optimum-location corollary of N-035's decay-constant law.

dg03_effective_size_is_duplication_struc.reason: Same hypothesis (effective dataset size of web corpora is a functional of the near-duplicate structure, not raw image count) with the same falsification (predict transfer / collapse scaling curves across corpora of different redundancy). N-043's histogram-derived effective-sample-size formula generalizes N-027's unique-cluster count; one program.

dg04_exposure_not_scale_onsets.reason: Same mechanism (capability onsets are exposure-driven: absolute count of capability-relevant examples, not model scale) and same design (data-level manipulation at matched compute, measure onset shift). N-044 injects exemplars; N-051 reweights toward the relevant slice - the substrate slot of one experiment.

dg05_representational_precursors.reason: Same hypothesis (representational precursors precede behavioral capability onset by a measurable compute lead, enabling early-warning forecasting) with the same lead-time-analysis design along public ladders; only the precursor instrument differs (linear-probe competence vs intrinsic-dimension/cluster geometry indices).

dg06_emergence_is_training_similar_retri.reason: Near-identical designs: stratify test items by nearest-neighbor similarity to an open pretraining corpus and decompose capability/accuracy curves per stratum along model ladders. N-052 claims emergent capabilities collapse on training-far strata; N-059 claims late-scale gains concentrate on training-similar strata - the same memorization-vs-abstraction attribution read at two points of one curve.

dg07_capacity_data_ratio_law.reason: Same mechanism (membership risk is governed by the parameters-per-unique-image ratio) and same design (attack AUC over a model-size x data-size training grid). N-071's 'bigger is not leakier along the joint scaling path' is the reading of N-065's collapsed risk surface along one diagonal; its inversion narrative survives in the primary's interpretation.

dg08_aggregation_membership.reason: Same mechanism (aggregating individually-insufficient per-image membership signals over a natural collection yields high-confidence dataset-inclusion tests) and same design (aggregate test power at controlled FPR vs per-image analysis). N-074's photos-per-user grouping is the user-level substrate of N-072's collection-level claim.

dg09_context_keyed_replay.reason: Same mechanism (dense models bind duplicated rare instances to their training context; context-similar queries elicit memorized-scene structure in outputs) and same manipulated variable (controlled duplication injection of instance-context panels). N-057 measures the failure mode (hallucinated detections on instance-removed scenes); N-081 weaponizes the identical signal as black-box extraction. The extraction arm survives as the primary's adversarial variant.

dg10_contamination_inflation_law.reason: N-085 (per-stratum inflation ratio grows with model scale for looser similarity strata) is one coefficient - the similarity x scale interaction - inside N-084's contamination inflation law fitted over injected duplication count, similarity stratum, and model scale. Same injection design, same inflation measurement. Factorial-primary precedent (w3 dg01).

dg11_upstream_downstream_decoupling.reason: Same hypothesis (the upstream-loss-to-downstream-gain exchange rate degrades along scale ladders, so upstream-loss planning overpromises) with the same design (fit upstream-vs-downstream trajectories along public compute ladders and test divergence). N-012 parameterizes the decay as a locatable break for dense tasks; N-097 as a continuous per-nat drift - two parametrizations of one curve.

dg12_scaling_structure_is_corpus_propert.reason: Same hypothesis (the structure of scaling curves - exponents and break locations - is a property of the corpus, architecture-invariant up to a multiplicative constant) with the same falsification family (fit scaling curves for FLOP-matched ConvNet vs ViT families on the same data; test parameter equality). N-099's corpus-recomposition arm (breaks shift together when the corpus changes) survives as the primary's escalation experiment.

dg13_frozen_evaluation_stack.reason: Same mechanism (unpinned evaluation stacks silently inject rank flips; freezing the stack removes them - the constructive repair of master C-077's harness-variance finding) and same measurement (cross-harness/environment rank-flip and score-drift counts vs a frozen reference). P-002 pins decoding semantics (thresholds/NMS/max-dets); P-030 pins the software container - two layers of one frozen-reference-harness contract.

dg14_variance_certificates.reason: Same mechanism (hierarchical variance decomposition over images/classes/seeds yields a minimum-resolvable-difference threshold; power-gating acceptance flips published conclusions) and same measurement (variance components + accept/reject flip counts). Substrate swap only: detection MDD certificate vs segmentation power tables. Family cap (eval_statistics_certificates, 7 candidates) co-fired.

dg15_declared_prior_reweighting.reason: P-008 (occlusion-stratified, deployment-weighted AP changes model selection) is the single-stratum instantiation of P-031's declared-prior evaluation interface (reweighted scores over scene/scale/occlusion strata with ESS-floor variance guarantees). Same mechanism and same measurement (model-selection changes under deployment-prior reweighting).

dg16_model_completed_test_labels.reason: Same mechanism (model-verified completion of incomplete test-set annotation moves scores toward the complete-annotation ideal and flips conclusions, at near-zero human cost) and same design (complete labels with gated/calibrated models, rescore a disjoint model set, compare shifts/rankings). P-007 is the instance-level COCO arm validated against human relabeling; P-011 the federated LVIS rare-category arm - the rare-class differential survives in the primary.

dg17_annotation_source_conditioning.reason: Same mechanism (condition the decoder on an annotation-source token so one model reproduces per-source labeling styles, beating consensus/blind-mix training) and same measurement (per-source accuracy plus transfer/interpolation to new sources). Substrate swap only: dataset-level convention token (P-014) vs individual rater embedding (P-015). Family cap (annotation_convention_control) co-fired; master rater-modeling family B-017/B-020/B-021 flagged on the primary.

dg18_precision_tiered_budgeting.reason: Same mechanism (non-uniform allocation of annotation precision beats uniform spending at matched budget) and same measurement (quality vs annotation-cost frontier). P-016 allocates a coarse/precise image tier split with a tolerance-weighted loss; P-024 allocates polygon vertex budgets by boundary complexity - the per-boundary substrate of the same allocation claim.

dg19_verified_negatives.reason: Same manipulated variable (verified-negative vs extra-positive label purchases at fixed budget) and same measurement (AP recovered per label added). P-023 buys certified-empty regions to repair federated/missing-label training; P-045 buys image-level verified negatives for weak supervision - Open Images validation path survives in the primary's fastest-falsification route.

dg20_order_supervised_amodal.reason: One pipeline split in two: P-047 claims pairwise over/under occlusion-order supervision suffices for amodal completion; P-049 supplies exactly that supervision label-free from T-junction geometry, and its own falsification already includes 'downstream amodal retention'. Family cap (amodal_extent_geometry, 8 candidates > 6) fired; merged as supervision-sufficiency + supervision-source stages of one system.

dg21_amodal_extent_replaces_visible_iou.reason: Same mechanism (visible-box IoU is the wrong geometry under occlusion; estimated amodal extent is the right one) and same measurement (occlusion-stratified detection recovery), applied at the two ends of one pipeline: training anchor assignment (P-048) and inference duplicate suppression (P-051). Family cap (amodal_extent_geometry) fired.

dg22_linear_map_head_reuse.reason: Same hypothesis (frozen backbones' feature spaces are equivalent up to a cheap map, so task heads transfer across backbones without task-label retraining) and same measurement (fraction of retrained-head performance recovered). P-065's label-free orthogonal Procrustes map is the constrained, sharper form of P-061's learned translator. Both collide with accepted master J-009 (linear-adapter head transfer across diffusion backbones); flag carried on the primary as this wave's top novelty risk.

dg23_assignment_mechanism_gates_merging.reason: Same hypothesis (what gates weight-space mergeability of dense models is decoder/assignment-family compatibility, not task relatedness or architecture names) and same design (merge grids with factorized compatibility attribution). P-070 sharpens P-063's governing-condition claim into a checkable predictive rule (Hungarian-matching vs dense-assignment identity). Family cap (weight_space_merging, 7 candidates) co-fired.

dg24_relation_statistics_rescoring.reason: One mechanism (learned pairwise object/class-relation statistics applied at output assembly recover relation-inconsistent errors at negligible headline-metric cost) instantiated three times: P-072's energy-based relational re-decoding over support/co-occurrence/relative-scale statistics is the general form; P-075 is its support-relation slice; P-076 its panoptic exclusion/adjacency-matrix slice. Same violation-removal-vs-metric-cost measurement. Family cap (decode_time_structural_constraints, 8 candidates > 6) fired.

dg25_taxonomy_backoff_decoding.reason: Same decode-time procedure (ascend the class taxonomy to the deepest sufficiently supported node over frozen logits, no retraining) and same measurement (mistake-severity vs specificity trade-off). Substrate swap only: WordNet classification (P-074) vs long-tail detection fallback (P-083). Family caps (decode_time_structural_constraints and long_tail_capability, both 7-8 candidates) co-fired.

dg26_grammar_constrained_2d_decoding.reason: Same mechanism (document notation is a 2D grammar; sequence decoders without grammar constraints emit structural errors invisible to string metrics; grammar-constrained decoding eliminates a countable error class) and same measurement (structural-metric vs string-metric divergence plus constrained-decoding recovery). Substrate swap only: table grids/merged cells (O-046) vs mathematical expression trees (O-055).

dg27_phenology_time_reparameterization.reason: Same mechanism (calendar-time encodings misalign vegetation phenology across years/regions/hemispheres; re-indexing time by a phenology-grounded variable recovers transfer) and same design (retrain identical temporal models under both indexings, compare transfer gaps). Substrate slots: thermal time from weather reanalysis + cross-year transfer (O-065) vs local vegetation-index phase + hemisphere transfer (O-072); the hemisphere arm survives as the primary's escalation.

mg01_duplication_memorization_dose_law.reason: Near-verbatim substrate port of an accepted master law. J-038 (accepted, gen_j): memorization probability vs log duplication count is sigmoidal with a capacity-dependent midpoint, usable for dedup policy. N-054 asserts the identical knee-shaped duplication dose-response with capacity/data-shifted knee for encoder membership signal, with the identical falsification (inject panel at controlled duplication counts, measure per-count signal) and the identical dedup-operating-point payoff; only the substrate differs (discriminative membership AUC vs generative verbatim extraction). The discriminative arm survives as a flag on kept N-053/N-062/N-067.

mg02_distillation_inherits_memorization.reason: Substrate port of accepted J-074 (distillation preferentially preserves memorized-item signal; students over-represent teacher memorization). N-070 asserts the same mechanism (teacher outputs on transfer data carry member-specific idiosyncrasies that students fit) with the same student-side attack falsification, moved from few-step generative students to encoder students with disjoint transfer data. Likeliest resurrection candidate if judges B/C rule the discriminative membership-AUC variant independently decisive.

mg03_rater_distribution_scoring.reason: Protocol instantiation of accepted B-095 (distribution-matching evaluation: predictions scored against the empirical rater distribution re-score a large share of hard-domain error and change rankings). P-021's set-valued best-match credit over multi-rater ground truth asserts the same mechanism with the same falsification (re-evaluate public models under consensus vs distribution/set scoring; count flips stratified by ambiguity). Master C-066/C-067 already occupy the adjacent agreement-ceiling ground.

mg04_noise_floor_normalized_metrics.reason: Substrate port of accepted D-096 (inter-annotator agreement defines a local noise floor; noise-floor-normalized strict-IoU metrics change scores and method orderings). P-034 asserts the same mechanism (estimate per-benchmark/per-class annotator ceilings from double-annotated subsets; report headroom-normalized scores; conclusions reorder) with the same flip-count falsification, generalized from detection IoU to leaderboards at large. C-025/C-066 occupy the adjacent ground.

mg05_model_derived_click_value.reason: Substrate port of accepted A-094 (per-pixel expected-mask-improvement click advisor beats human/heuristic click placement, measured by clicks-to-quality). P-087 asserts the same hypothesis (click value is a function of prediction state; model-derived placement dominates the fixed heuristic) with the same clicks-to-quality falsification; the advisor construction (learned lookahead policy vs sensitivity-map estimate) is an implementation slot, not a mechanism difference.

amodal_extent_geometry.action: FIRED: 8 candidates > cap 6; merged P-049->P-047 (supervision source into sufficiency claim) and P-051->P-048 (inference suppression into training assignment; one amodal-extent-replaces-visible-IoU program).

decode_time_structural_constraints_visio.action: FIRED: 8 candidates > cap 6; merged P-075->P-072 and P-076->P-072 (relation-statistics rescoring slices) and P-083->P-074 (taxonomy backoff; shared with long_tail cell).

long_tail_capability.action: FIRED: 7 candidates > cap 6; satisfied by P-083->P-074 merge (taxonomy backoff decoded once, not per-cell).

weight_space_merging.action: FIRED: 7 candidates > cap 6; merged P-063->P-070 (assignment-mechanism rule sharpens the decoder-compatibility condition).

annotation_convention_control.action: CO-FIRED at cap 6 (master annotation-convention family additionally over-occupied per w2 ruling): merged P-015->P-014 (rater-embedding substrate) and killed P-021->B-095 (master collision). P-064 dual-assigned to weight_space_merging.

eval_statistics_certificates.action: CO-FIRED: 7 candidates > cap 6; merged P-027->P-004 (segmentation power tables = MDD certificate substrate).

deliberate_tensions.W13-P1-N-029: vs N-010/N-098: per-concept exponents are near-universal and shared (N-029) vs exponents are set by label granularity (N-010) and strongly slice-heterogeneous (N-098). One resampling grid can adjudicate.
deliberate_tensions.W13-P1-N-040: vs N-062/J-038 dedup policy: near-duplicates are free hard positives for fine-grained recognition (keep them) vs duplication is the memorization dose variable (remove them). The dedup threshold is a utility-privacy operating point, not a constant.
deliberate_tensions.W13-P1-N-035: vs N-042: vision tolerates heavy repetition (utility view) vs memorization onset precedes utility loss under repetition (privacy view). Same epoch axis, opposite stopping rules.
deliberate_tensions.W13-P1-P-079: vs P-098: exploit context co-occurrence (context-matched pasting for the tail) vs train context invariance (context-swap training). N-033 dose-response is the natural arbiter.

deliberate_tensions.W13-P1-N-047: vs P-093/P-095: attribute-object binding is limited by pretraining decorrelation statistics (data view) vs recoverable by gradient-reversal factorization or region-tokenized pooling on existing data (architecture view).
